info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts Care plan API
Get a list of care plan base information using the client Alayacare ID

params.name: client_id
params.description: Send request using the client Alayacare ID

params.name: start_date_from
params.description:
Filter by care plan start date time greater or equal than specified value.
If not specified will default to now.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
`start_date_from` can be used as this filter name.
Ex: `2018-02-03T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: start_date_to
params.description:
Filter by care plan start date time less than or equal than specified value.
If not specified will default to 7 days from now.
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
`start_date_to` can be used as this filter name
Ex: `2019-02-18T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: end_date_from
params.description:
Filter by care plan end date time greater or equal than specified value. 
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
Ex: `2019-02-03T08:00:00-05:00`

params.name: end_date_to
params.description:
Filter by care plan date time less than or equal than specified value. 
Expected format is ISO 8601 converted to UTC timezone.
Ex: `2018-02-18T08:00:00-05:00`

info.name: Get the detailed information of the active care plan using Alayacare client ID

params.name: client_id
params.description: Send request using Alayacare client DB ID

params.name: root_item_id
params.description: Only return the details for the specified root item ID (`diagnosis`, `goal` and `intervention` IDs)

params.name: root_item_type
params.description: Only return the details for the specified root items type (`diagnosis`, `goal` or `intervention`)

params.name: from
params.description: Set the start date of the search period for the root items (`diagnosis`, `goal` and `intervention`) (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: to
params.description: Set the end date of the search period for the root items (`diagnosis`, `goal` and `intervention`) (YYYY-MM-DD)

items.docs:
Deprecated. Use /careplans/currently-active instead.
Returns the detailed information of the active careplan, including all sub entities referenced as `root_item` (`diagnosis`, `goal` and `intervention`)

- Specifying `root_item_id` and `root_item_type` filters will return the `root_item` and any item linked to it.   Both filters must be valid and specified together or an error will be returned.
- For example, if a specific `diagnosis_id` is linked to 2 goals then the 3 entities will be returned

info.name: Change status of care plan to active using the care plan ID

items.docs:
- If a care plan is in `completed` or `archived` status, then the care plan cannot be re-activated again.
- Only `one` care plan can be active at a time.
- If an existing care plan is currently active, and you wish to create and activate a new care plan, then the `start_date` of the new care plan must be `after` the `start _date` of the currently active care plan.

info.name: Change status of care plan to archived using the care plan ID

items.docs: - Care plans in active status must be completed before they can be archived.
